headlines.title: S&P Global raises Western Digital outlook to positive on surging AI demand
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings has revised its outlook on Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) to positive from stable while affirming its 'BBB-' issuer credit rating, pointing to accelerating cash flow generation and sustained low leverage. The revision signals potential upward mobility for the data storage manufacturer's credit profile as booming demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure fuels rapid top-line growth.

headlines.title: Western Digital, FormFactor, Penguin Solutions, Himax, and Power Integrations Shares Are Falling, What You Need To Know
headlines.summary: A number of stocks fell in the morning session after benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury yields rose above 5.1%, renewing pressure on high-multiple technology valuations. The pullback follows a six-session climb that had lifted the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index by 14% since the start of the week, according to Nasdaq index data.

headlines.title: Newegg Business Partners with Western Digital to Help IT Teams Scale Storage for AI-Driven NAS Environments
headlines.summary: DIAMOND BAR, Calif., September 24, 2026--Newegg (Newegg Commerce, Inc., NASDAQ: NEGG), a global leader in computer and technology products, today announced that Newegg Business will help IT teams choose and deploy storage built to keep up with AI-driven data growth. Newegg Business will host a live webinar in collaboration with Western Digital, "Realize the Full Power of Your AI NAS with WD Red® Pro," on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. PT.

headlines.title: Micron (MU) vs Western Digital (WDC): Which is a Better Stock to Buy
headlines.summary: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) and Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) have both been transformed by the AI buildout, and both are effectively sold out. Micron has signed long-term supply agreements that run to the end of the decade, with customers putting down deposits to hold their place in the queue.

headlines.title: Western Digital (WDC) Could Be 41% Overvalued Ahead Of Earnings
headlines.summary: Western Digital (WDC) heads into an upcoming earnings release that has drawn fresh attention, as recent commentary highlights expectations for year-over-year gains in both profit and revenue, alongside a Zacks Rank of #2. Western Digital’s recent share price action has been punchy, with a 3.67% 1-day share price return and 12.78% 7-day share price return at a last close of US$464.60. This comes even though the 90-day share price return declined 27.

description: Western Digital Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of data storage devices and solutions based on hard disk drive (HDD) technology in the United States, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers internal HDDs, data center drives, data center platforms, external drives, portable drives, NAS for home and office, and accessories. It sells its data storage devices and solutions through its computer sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. The company has a collaboration with Open Quantum Design for the development of quantum error correction technology and related systems to advance reliable quantum computing. Western Digital Corporation was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
